About
01 / profile

Inventor-minded.
Impact-driven.

"Innovation distinguishes between a leader and a follower."
— Steve Jobs · a guiding principle

Since a very young age, I've dreamed of becoming an inventor — someone capable of creating something truly new and meaningful for the future. This passion for innovation led me to Biomedical Engineering, where technology and healthcare come together to improve lives.

I thrive on constant challenges, driven by deep curiosity and an endless desire to learn. Highly organised and goal-oriented, I believe structure and focus are the foundations of meaningful impact.
